mapper.select: /*selectJobList*/ SELECT JOB_ID AS job_id, JOB_NAME AS job_name, ENABLE_YN AS enable_yn, TO_CHAR(INTERVAL_MIN) AS interval_min, TO_CHAR(LIMIT_CNT) AS limit_cnt, TO_CHAR(STALE_DAYS) AS stale_days, COUNTRY_CODE AS country_code, RUNNING_YN AS running_yn, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_start_dt, TO_CHAR(LAST_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_end_dt, LAST_RESULT_CODE AS last_result_code, LAST_RESULT_MSG AS last_result_msg, TO_CHAR(LAST_RUN_CNT) AS last_run_cnt, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, TO_CHAR(MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mod_dt FROM TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL ORDER BY JOB_ID

/*selectJobOne*/ SELECT JOB_ID AS job_id, JOB_NAME AS job_name, ENABLE_YN AS enable_yn, TO_CHAR(INTERVAL_MIN) AS interval_min, TO_CHAR(LIMIT_CNT) AS limit_cnt, TO_CHAR(STALE_DAYS) AS stale_days, COUNTRY_CODE AS country_code, RUNNING_YN AS running_yn, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_start_dt, TO_CHAR(LAST_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_end_dt, LAST_RESULT_CODE AS last_result_code, LAST_RESULT_MSG AS last_result_msg, TO_CHAR(LAST_RUN_CNT) AS last_run_cnt, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, TO_CHAR(MOD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mod_dt FROM TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
mapper.insert: /*insertJobCtrl*/ INSERT INTO TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL ( JOB_ID, JOB_NAME, ENABLE_YN, INTERVAL_MIN, LIMIT_CNT, STALE_DAYS, COUNTRY_CODE, RUNNING_YN, REG_DT, MOD_DT ) VALUES ( #{job_id}, #{job_name}, #{enable_yn}, TO_NUMBER(#{interval_min}), TO_NUMBER(#{limit_cnt}), TO_NUMBER(#{stale_days}), #{country_code}, 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: /*tryLock*/ UPDATE TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL SET RUNNING_YN = 'Y' , LAST_START_DT = SYSDATE , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id} AND RUNNING_YN = 'N'

/*forceClearRunningIfStale*/ UPDATE TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL SET RUNNING_YN = 'N' , LAST_END_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_RESULT_CODE = 'ERROR' , LAST_RESULT_MSG = #{last_result_msg} , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id} AND RUNNING_YN = 'Y' AND LAST_START_DT IS NOT NULL AND LAST_START_DT < (SYSDATE - (TO_NUMBER(#{stale_minutes}) / (24*60)))
mapper.select: /*isDue*/ SELECT CASE WHEN LAST_START_DT IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN (LAST_START_DT + (INTERVAL_MIN / (24*60))) <= SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DUE FROM TB_S_BATCH_JOB_CTRL WHERE JOB_ID = #{job_id}
mapper.update: /*mergeKospi200InterestStock*/ MERGE INTO TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK T USING ( SELECT #{stock_code} AS STOCK_CODE , #{stock_country_code} AS STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE AND NVL(T.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE,'KR') = S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STOCK_KO_NAME = NVL(#{stock_ko_name}, T.STOCK_KO_NAME) , T.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = #{stock_country_code} , T.STOCK_TIMEZONE = NVL(#{stock_timezone}, T.STOCK_TIMEZONE) , T.STOCK_CURRENCY = NVL(#{stock_currency}, T.STOCK_CURRENCY) , T.USE_DIV = 'Y' , T.STOCK_ALIASES = CASE WHEN T.STOCK_ALIASES IS NULL OR T.STOCK_ALIASES = '' THEN #{stock_aliases} WHEN INSTR(T.STOCK_ALIASES, #{tag}) > 0 THEN T.STOCK_ALIASES ELSE T.STOCK_ALIASES || '|' || #{tag} END , T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_SEQ, STOCK_ID, STOCK_CODE, STOCK_KO_NAME, STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, STOCK_TIMEZONE, STOCK_CURRENCY, STOCK_ALIASES, USE_DIV, MODIFY_DATE, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(STOCK_SEQ),0)+1 FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK), SYS_GUID(), #{stock_code}, #{stock_ko_name}, #{stock_country_code}, #{stock_timezone}, #{stock_currency}, #{stock_aliases}, 'Y', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
